peon.title: Task Fields
peon.text:
Three columns: to do, in work, done.
Pull 'Review auth refresh PR' into work,
and an orc picks it up.

alt.camp: Task Fields kanban: Rotate signing keys and Token TTL to do, Review auth refresh PR and PKCE exchange in progress, OAuth client and Login form done (Camp mode)
alt.office: Task Fields kanban: Rotate signing keys and Token TTL to do, Review auth refresh PR and PKCE exchange in progress, OAuth client and Login form done (Office mode)

peon.title: Barracks
peon.text:
Three orcs, three git worktrees, one queue.
A follow-up goes to the orc that wrote the first part.
The foreman says why it hired whom.

alt.camp: Barracks: three orcs each working a task in its own worktree (PKCE flow, Token TTL, Reuse check), one task queued, a failed task in the finished list (Camp mode)
alt.office: Barracks: three orcs each working a task in its own worktree (PKCE flow, Token TTL, Reuse check), one task queued, a failed task in the finished list (Office mode)

peon.title: The Forge

alt.camp: The Forge: branches feat/oauth with open PR #41 'Review auth refresh PR', fix/ttl with PR #42 and chore/deps, with lines changed and commits ahead (Camp mode)
alt.office: The Forge: branches feat/oauth with open PR #41 'Review auth refresh PR', fix/ttl with PR #42 and chore/deps, with lines changed and commits ahead (Office mode)

peon.title: Lake of Insight
peon.text:
Review the agent's diff side by side,
not as a wall of chat:
auth/token.py on feat/oauth, before | after.

alt.camp: Lake of Insight: side-by-side diff of auth/token.py on feat/oauth, before on the left and after on the right (Camp mode)
alt.office: Lake of Insight: side-by-side diff of auth/token.py on feat/oauth, before on the left and after on the right (Office mode)

peon.title: Orc Council
peon.text:
Diff Inspector and Test Runner review the patch.
An objection sends it back: round 3 of 4,
with a hard cap on rounds and dollars.

alt.camp: Orc Council reviewing the feat/oauth patch, round 3 of 4: Diff Inspector agrees, Test Runner objects that an expired code is accepted (Camp mode)
alt.office: Orc Council reviewing the feat/oauth patch, round 3 of 4: Diff Inspector agrees, Test Runner objects that an expired code is accepted (Office mode)

peon.title: Watchtower
peon.text:
Watches GitHub for you: a PR opened,
a review requested, a check failed.
Each event rolls down a road to whoever handles it.

alt.camp: Watchtower GitHub feed: check 'unit' failed, review asked on PR #41, PR #42 opened, with the failed check open on the right (Camp mode)
alt.office: Watchtower GitHub feed: check 'unit' failed, review asked on PR #41, PR #42 opened, with the failed check open on the right (Office mode)

peon.title: Loot Vault
peon.text:
What the agents wrote, waiting for a yes:
CHANGELOG for v0.9.0, release notes.
Accept it, or roll it back.

alt.camp: Loot Vault: CHANGELOG.md and docs/release.md written by agents, waiting to be accepted, with the v0.9.0 changelog previewed (Camp mode)
alt.office: Loot Vault: CHANGELOG.md and docs/release.md written by agents, waiting to be accepted, with the v0.9.0 changelog previewed (Office mode)

peon.title: Tally Crag
peon.text:
Tokens per building over the last 24 h.
The Forge ate 174k; the Lake 77k.
A bar turns red past the limit you set.

alt.camp: Tally Crag: tokens per building over 24 hours, 332k in total, the Forge's 174k bar in red over the limit (Camp mode)
alt.office: Tally Crag: tokens per building over 24 hours, 332k in total, the Forge's 174k bar in red over the limit (Office mode)

knight.title: Launch Board
knight.text:
Code, copy and launch on one board:
'Stripe webhooks', 'Launch post and pricing page',
'Fix checkout 500'. Nothing lives in your head.

alt.camp: Launch Board kanban: Launch post and pricing page and Product Hunt draft to do, Stripe webhooks and Fix checkout 500 in progress, Landing hero and Waitlist email done (Camp mode)
alt.office: Launch Board kanban: Launch post and pricing page and Product Hunt draft to do, Stripe webhooks and Fix checkout 500 in progress, Landing hero and Waitlist email done (Office mode)

knight.title: Barracks
knight.text:
While you write the launch post,
two orcs take Stripe webhooks and the 500 fix,
each in its own worktree. Hard cap: $5.

alt.camp: Barracks: two orcs at work, Smith on Stripe webhooks and Scout on Fix checkout 500, with Usage emails queued and a $5 budget (Camp mode)
alt.office: Barracks: two orcs at work, Smith on Stripe webhooks and Scout on Fix checkout 500, with Usage emails queued and a $5 budget (Office mode)

knight.title: Tally Crag
knight.text:
Your own money, per building:
Barracks $2.20, Forge $0.90 today.
Yellow at the warn line, red at the cap.

alt.camp: Tally Crag: spend in dollars per building over 24 hours, $3.67 in total, the Barracks' $2.20 bar in orange over the warn line (Camp mode)
alt.office: Tally Crag: spend in dollars per building over 24 hours, $3.67 in total, the Barracks' $2.20 bar in orange over the warn line (Office mode)

knight.title: Watchtower
knight.text:
After the deploy it keeps watch:
a Sentry alert mail, a refund request,
a failed check. You get the cart, not the noise.

alt.camp: Watchtower feed after a deploy: a Sentry 500 alert on /api/checkout, a failed e2e check and a refund request mail (Camp mode)
alt.office: Watchtower feed after a deploy: a Sentry 500 alert on /api/checkout, a failed e2e check and a refund request mail (Office mode)

knight.title: The Forge
knight.text:
feat/stripe: PR #12 open, +413 −3.
One key tests it and squash-merges it into main.
Red tests keep the gate shut.

alt.camp: The Forge: branch feat/stripe with open PR #12 'Stripe billing' (+413 −3) and fix/checkout with PR #13 (Camp mode)
alt.office: The Forge: branch feat/stripe with open PR #12 'Stripe billing' (+413 −3) and fix/checkout with PR #13 (Office mode)

knight.title: Loot Vault
knight.text:
The launch post, HN and Product Hunt drafts,
the pricing page copy: read it, accept it,
or roll it back.

alt.camp: Loot Vault: launch.md, hn.md, ph.md and pricing.md written by agents, waiting to be accepted, the Show HN draft previewed (Camp mode)
alt.office: Loot Vault: launch.md, hn.md, ph.md and pricing.md written by agents, waiting to be accepted, the Show HN draft previewed (Office mode)

knight.title: Town Hall
knight.text:
Say what you need: 'post every merged PR to the changelog'.
The Builder plans it; you approve before anything stands.
Z undoes any building.

alt.camp: Town Hall: the order 'post every merged PR to the changelog' waiting for the Town Builder's plan and your approval (Camp mode)
alt.office: Town Hall: the order 'post every merged PR to the changelog' waiting for the Town Builder's plan and your approval (Office mode)

knight.title: The Catapult
knight.text:
Waits for the build, the notes and the board,
checks them against a schema,
then fires the release to your webhook.

alt.camp: The Catapult: build, notes and board all loaded, checked against the release schema, and a dry-run POST to the release webhook (Camp mode)
alt.office: The Catapult: build, notes and board all loaded, checked against the release schema, and a dry-run POST to the release webhook (Office mode)

elf.title: Loot Vault
elf.text:
'Hero section, 3 variants' land as files.
Approve hero-b, roll back a and c.
Nothing reaches the repo without your yes.

alt.camp: Loot Vault: three hero variants as files, hero-b accepted with its ASCII wireframe 'Invoices in one click, Start free' previewed, hero-a and hero-c waiting (Camp mode)
alt.office: Loot Vault: three hero variants as files, hero-b accepted with its ASCII wireframe 'Invoices in one click, Start free' previewed, hero-a and hero-c waiting (Office mode)

elf.title: Lake of Insight
elf.text:
Two versions of the error copy, side by side:
'Something went wrong' or 'We couldn't
reach your bank'. Pick one, no doc ping-pong.

alt.camp: Lake of Insight: two versions of the bank-connection error copy side by side, 'Something went wrong' before and 'We couldn't reach your bank' after (Camp mode)
alt.office: Lake of Insight: two versions of the bank-connection error copy side by side, 'Something went wrong' before and 'We couldn't reach your bank' after (Office mode)

elf.title: Orc Council
elf.text:
A Critic, an Accessibility orc and a Copy orc
critique the onboarding flow until they agree.
Objections come back as a list, round by round.

alt.camp: Orc Council critiquing the onboarding flow, agreed in round 2: the Accessibility orc's objection that focus jumps to the footer is open (Camp mode)
alt.office: Orc Council critiquing the onboarding flow, agreed in round 2: the Accessibility orc's objection that focus jumps to the footer is open (Office mode)

elf.title: Token Mill
elf.text:
Design tokens JSON in, CSS variables out.
Regexes and templates, no model,
so rebuilding the tokens costs nothing.

alt.camp: Token Mill: design tokens JSON run through three steps with no model, out come CSS variables for primary color, ink, radius, spacing and body font (Camp mode)
alt.office: Token Mill: design tokens JSON run through three steps with no model, out come CSS variables for primary color, ink, radius, spacing and body font (Office mode)

elf.title: The Pit
elf.text:
Drop screenshots, paste a moodboard link
or a client note. No dialog, no form:
the Scavenger sorts it to the right building.

alt.camp: The Pit: two reference images, a moodboard link and a client note ('make the CTA warmer') dropped in and sorted by kind (Camp mode)
alt.office: The Pit: two reference images, a moodboard link and a client note ('make the CTA warmer') dropped in and sorted by kind (Office mode)

elf.title: Task Fields
elf.text:
Every screen through its states:
'Onboarding step 2: empty, loading, error'.
Done only when all four are.

alt.camp: Task Fields: onboarding screens by state, error and empty states to do, loading and Hero 3 variants in progress, step 1 with all 4 states done (Camp mode)
alt.office: Task Fields: onboarding screens by state, error and empty states to do, loading and Hero 3 variants in progress, step 1 with all 4 states done (Office mode)

elf.title: Scroll Dump
elf.text:
Your design guidelines and component notes.
Agents get only the fragment they need,
and personal notes never reach a model.

alt.camp: Scroll Dump: the design guidelines base with Buttons, Spacing and Voice and tone; a search for 'errors' returns one fragment from Voice and tone (Camp mode)
alt.office: Scroll Dump: the design guidelines base with Buttons, Spacing and Voice and tone; a search for 'errors' returns one fragment from Voice and tone (Office mode)

elf.title: The Forge
elf.text:
Hand off chore/tokens-v2 as PR #7:
the tests run first,
then one key squash-merges it.

alt.camp: The Forge: branch chore/tokens-v2 with open PR #7 'Tokens v2' highlighted, next to the draft PR #8 for error copy v2 (Camp mode)
alt.office: The Forge: branch chore/tokens-v2 with open PR #7 'Tokens v2' highlighted, next to the draft PR #8 for error copy v2 (Office mode)

lich.title: Sprint Board
lich.text:
Sprint 14 at a glance: 9 to do, 4 in work,
6 done. 'Security review OAuth' sits
where everyone can see it.

alt.camp: Sprint Board for Sprint 14: 9 to do, 4 in progress including Security review OAuth and Checkout 500, 6 done (Camp mode)
alt.office: Sprint Board for Sprint 14: 9 to do, 4 in progress including Security review OAuth and Checkout 500, 6 done (Office mode)

lich.title: Loot Vault
lich.text:
'Sprint 14 status digest' arrives every morning
as a report: 6 events, 2 blockers.
Kept with when it came and what it cost.

alt.camp: Loot Vault with the stored 'Sprint 14 status digest' report (6 events, 2 blockers), with when it came and what it cost ($0.04) (Camp mode)
alt.office: Loot Vault with the stored 'Sprint 14 status digest' report (6 events, 2 blockers), with when it came and what it cost ($0.04) (Office mode)

lich.title: Tally Crag
lich.text:
Sprint 14 in bars: 9 to do, 4 in work, 6 done.
One key flips it to spend or runs,
with a warn line and a cap you set.

alt.camp: Tally Crag: Sprint 14 tasks per column as bars, 9 to do, 4 in progress, 6 done (Camp mode)
alt.office: Tally Crag: Sprint 14 tasks per column as bars, 9 to do, 4 in progress, 6 done (Office mode)

lich.title: Watchtower
lich.text:
Watches GitHub, mail and the schedule:
'#41 review waiting 2 days'
lands here, not in a lost thread.

alt.camp: Watchtower escalations: '#41 review waiting 2 d' open, a failed check on main, a client mail and the 09:00 digest (Camp mode)
alt.office: Watchtower escalations: '#41 review waiting 2 d' open, a failed check on main, a client mail and the 09:00 digest (Office mode)

lich.title: War Drum
lich.text:
Your calendar as the day's rhythm:
10:00 standup, 14:00 Sprint 14 review.
What is now and what is next, nothing else.

alt.camp: War Drum for today: 10:00 Standup next, then 1:1 with Mira, Sprint 14 review at 14:00 and Sprint 15 planning at 16:00 (Camp mode)
alt.office: War Drum for today: 10:00 Standup next, then 1:1 with Mira, Sprint 14 review at 14:00 and Sprint 15 planning at 16:00 (Office mode)

lich.title: Orc Council
lich.text:
Planner, Critic and Security agree on
the Sprint 15 plan before you read it:
11 stories cut to 8. Max 3 rounds, max $2.

alt.camp: Orc Council agreed on the Sprint 15 plan in round 2 of 3 for $0.38; the Critic's objection '11 stories, velocity is 8' is open (Camp mode)
alt.office: Orc Council agreed on the Sprint 15 plan in round 2 of 3 for $0.38; the Critic's objection '11 stories, velocity is 8' is open (Office mode)

lich.title: Barracks
lich.text:
Who works on what right now:
two orcs busy, one task waiting.
Every assignment comes with its reason.

alt.camp: Barracks: two orcs busy on Pricing page and Usage emails, and the foreman's log of who got which task and why (Camp mode)
alt.office: Barracks: two orcs busy on Pricing page and Usage emails, and the foreman's log of who got which task and why (Office mode)

lich.title: Scroll Dump
lich.text:
Meeting notes, decisions, ADRs in one place.
Agents quote the decision, not the whole wiki.
1:1 notes stay personal.

alt.camp: Scroll Dump of team notes (a 1:1, ADR-014, a retro); a search for 'decision' returns one fragment from ADR-014 Payments (Camp mode)
alt.office: Scroll Dump of team notes (a 1:1, ADR-014, a retro); a search for 'decision' returns one fragment from ADR-014 Payments (Office mode)
